name: Il Fado de Rie
original_name: イル・ファド・デ・リエ
source:
A fallen angel who loves otome games from the Heavenly World 'Caelm'.
A good young man who is courteous and has a graceful manner.
He goes at his own pace, is an airhead, and isn't that knowledgeable about the world, but he is smart and has an intellectual side.
Because of his soft nature, people are very helpful towards him and he gets pampered.
He's usually cooped up in his room playing otome games. He has an extremely beautiful singing voice.
